Among the three martial arts in which UFC legend Anderson Silva holds a black belt — judo, taekwondo, and one other — which grappling discipline, developed in Brazil, completes the trio?
questions.explanation: Anderson Silva, widely regarded as one of the greatest MMA fighters of all time, holds black belts in judo, taekwondo, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, developed in Brazil from Kodokan judo, emphasizes ground fighting and submission holds. Silva's diverse martial arts background contributed to his dominant 16-fight UFC middleweight winning streak.
